rows.en: Baio: "Whew... Honestly! Getting so worked up
over a mere unauthorized sortie... Proving Bine Daga's performance
would benefit Zigrim!
Well, never mind. They can bark all they want,
but no one can stand in my way!"
Bio: "...Still following your own path as always, Brother."
Celea: "It's been a long time."
Baio: "Oh, it's you."
Bio: "Isn't that a rather cold greeting
for your beloved younger brother?"
Baio: "Who is supposed to 'love' whom?!"
Celea: "Oh, dear brother, you're blushing."
Baio: "Hmph!"
Bio: "What's wrong today?
It's hardly unusual for General Growster to chew you out."
Baio: "That is none of your business.
...So, what do you want?"
Bio: "Oh, right. I came to report
that Daguel and Bazold have sold.
Well, the buyers are Dawn of an Era, though."
Baio: "You're still helping those terrorists?
What about the contract with the mercenaries?"
Bio: "Don't worry. I've worked things out on my end.
Besides, this deal was more profitable."
Baio: "Honestly, all you ever think about is profit..."
Bio: "More importantly, did you know
Ze=Ode was behind Zigrim?
That man Lyle seems to be one of them."
Baio: "...Come to think of it, that machine called Hestia earlier
did seem to follow a different design lineage..."
Bio: "With someone like that around, we'd be out of business, wouldn't we?"
Baio: "!! I see! That's why they were reluctant
to buy Bine Daga! Damn them... Are they saying my Bine Daga
is inferior to Ze=Ode?!"
Bio: "...I think that's an accurate assessment."
Baio: "What did you say?!"
Celea: "Oh, dear brother...
An expression like that doesn't suit you."
Baio: "Aaagh, don't touch me!
Trying to charm me is a waste of time!
Shoo, shoo, shoo!"
Celea: "Oh, how scaaary."
Bio: "There, there.
My brother is jealous of our relationship..."
Baio: "Who is?! If you're done, get out!"
Bio: "Now, now, calm down. This is today's real business.
...Actually, I have a proposal for you, Brother.
That woman you took in... She was summoned, wasn't she?"
Baio: "Wh... Why bring that up all of a sudden?!
O-of c-c-course she wasn't..."
Bio: "You've never been able to lie, Brother.
I see. So I was right."
Baio: "Y-you were fishing for information?!
My own brother, using such a sneaky trick..."
Bio: "Thank you for the compliment.
...Now, about that proposal..."
Baio: "...Melissa... What should I do?
I want to stay with you like this.
But that wouldn't make you happy...
And yet I... I..."
Melissa: "Doctor...?"
Baio: "O-oh... How are you feeling?"
Melissa: "I'm all right. I'm sorry I worried you.
And about Bine Daga..."
Baio: "No, never mind. I can simply repair it again.
You're not a machine. I can't just repair you."
Melissa: "..."
Baio: "Hm? What's wrong?"
Melissa: "What?! Oh, I'm sorry... It's nothing..."
Baio: "I see. W-well, I'm glad you're looking well. Very glad."
Melissa: "Heh heh heh... Thank you."
Baio: "Th-there's no need to be so f-formal..."
Melissa: "Heh heh heh."
Baio: "W-when you're better, we'll start testing again!
B-be ready for it!
I'm going to adjust Bine Daga!"
Melissa: "Heh heh heh."
Melissa: "...I am... Melissa Gould...
Pilot of the Spirit Mech Ahti..."
Baio: "...No... I can't let you go...
Ymir: "Me... A new leader...?
But I have neither the qualifications nor the power.
So why...?"
Horem: "Oh my, it seems you do not understand
your own worth.
There is your own ability, of course,
but above all, the blood flowing through your body. That is..."
Cain: "Is this really the time for such a leisurely conversation?"
Ymir: "Prince Cain..."
Cain: "Hello. Thank you for the other day."
Ymir: "Why are you here...?"
Cain: "Didn't I tell you before?
I've been disinherited.
So it isn't strange for me to be here, is it?
Oh, but I'm not depending on Zigrim's hospitality.
I chose this place as a temporary perch...
That is all."
Ymir: "Could you be... Prince Cain...?"
Cain: "It's been a while. Three years since we last met in person, perhaps?"
Ymir: "Yes. You disappeared so suddenly,
everyone was worried about you."
Cain: "Heh... Worried, were they?"
Ymir: "...Your Highness, you've changed."
Cain: "No. I've become stronger.
Strong enough that I needn't rely on anyone."
Horem: "Could you leave the happy reunion at that
and tell me what you came for?"
Cain: "Oh, right.
Mr. President, you have visitors.
Or, more precisely, Ymir, perhaps they're here for you."
Horem: "I see. Perhaps I underestimated
their abilities a little. My apologies, but could you
contact Mr. Briar for me?"
Cain: "Me?"
Horem: "Yes. Please do."
Cain: "...All right.
You certainly know how to work people..."

review_batches.context: Baio/Bio/Celea discuss sales and Ze=Ode; Bio probes the summoned woman's identity; Baio speaks privately with Melissa and cannot let her go. All 118 source rows examined, including the following separate Ymir/Horem scene.
review_batches.decisions: Keep Baio and Bio distinct, all named models and terrorist group, Hestia design observation, unwanted flirtation, Bio's information fishing, Melissa's recollected identity and Baio's conflict/possessiveness. Do not invent the proposal's terms, a memory-cure mechanism or a confirmed romantic relationship. Preserve all row boundaries, hesitations and unfinished thoughts.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00050.l00: Unauthorized sortie is Baio's minimization of Growster's complaint. Do not describe it as a permitted test or endorse Baio's excuse as narration.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o001b4.l00: Celea's dear brother address is playful flattery toward her partner's older brother; do not invent a marriage or biological sibling relationship.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00251.l00: Daguel and Bazold both sold to Dawn of an Era. Keep the separate mercenary contract concern and Bio's claim that he already settled it.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00342.l02: Bio suspects Lyle is associated with Ze=Ode; preserve seems rather than making his deduction an omniscient reveal.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00397.l00: Baio notices Hestia's different design lineage. No specific technology tree or production origin is supplied.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o003fe.l00: Baio explains the refusal to buy Bine Daga in terms of Ze=Ode competition; this is his inference and wounded pride, not proven procurement history.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o004c4.l00: Baio explicitly rejects being touched/charmed. Preserve his refusal rather than making the interaction mutually welcomed.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00518.l01: Bio claims jealousy to tease Baio; it is not independently narrated fact.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o0056f.l02: Woman you took in refers to Melissa, not a new unnamed employee. Summoned concerns her world of origin, not a legal summons.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00640.l00: Bio was fishing for information and uses Baio's reaction as confirmation. Do not invent prior certainty or a technical interrogation device.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00676.l01: The proposal itself is not stated before the scene changes. Preserve the unfinished line without inventing a sale, exchange or condition.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o006f0.l00: Baio admits his wish to stay together may not be Melissa's happiness. Keep that conflict and the later cannot-let-you-go line, without softening possession into mere concern.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00793.l01: Melissa starts apologizing about Bine Daga; Baio interrupts by distinguishing a repairable machine from her safety.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o008df.l00: Further tests are conditional on recovery, not an order that she start immediately while hurt.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o0094b.l00: Melissa voices her name and Ahti pilot identity hesitantly. Do not declare complete memory recovery or fill in other relationships here.

review_batches.context: Baio's last hesitation, then captive Ymir/Horem with alternate Cain introductions or a three-year reunion and a request to contact Briar. Final 38 rows; all 118 examined.
review_batches.decisions: Keep Horem's unfinished bloodline implication, Ymir's stated lack of qualification/power, Cain's disinheritance and chosen temporary shelter, and both knowledge-state branches. Briar is Vales's surname; use the source surname without premature full-name substitution. Restore who requests contact from whom. Source fragments and continuations remain deliberate.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00a4e.l00: Ymir questions being a new leader and says she lacks qualifications and power. Do not convert it into an accepted appointment.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00a9c.p01.l01: Horem's bloodline implication is interrupted. No parent, ancestor or political lineage is supplied in the translation.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00b5d.l00: One source branch recognizes Cain immediately; the separate could-you-be line at 98 is the alternate recognition path. Do not merge their knowledge states.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00baf.l01: Cain says he was disinherited, then insists he chose Zigrim as a temporary perch. Preserve the distinction between loss of succession and voluntary current refuge.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00c6d.l00: Three years since meeting in person remains a tentative count, with his disappearance and changed behavior discussed afterward.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00d01.l00: Cain rejects changed and substitutes stronger/self-reliant; preserve that self-assessment rather than narrating an objective personality diagnosis.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00d65.l02: Visitors are perhaps more accurately for Ymir, rather than an explicitly named arriving force or a settled surrender demand.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00f.o00da9.l02: Briar is the glossary surname of Vales Briar; Horem asks Cain to make contact. Do not reverse it into Cain asking Horem to call or introduce a separate person.
